annotations.title: ToolFit: Diff a tool list against a pin

description:
What changed in a tool list since you approved it? Compares "tools" or "url" now with "pin" (set_id from audit_tools/diff_tools) or "baseline" (earlier definitions). Each change is labeled breaking (removed tool or param, new required param, type or enum removal), suspicious (new text with injection patterns or hidden characters), review (description, title, annotation or new tool) or additive; descriptions come with before/after text and a word diff. Returns a new pin. Free: 20 calls/day per IP (shared with audit_tools), then $0.002 via x402 or credits.
Not for: a first audit (use audit_tools to create the pin).

[ToolFit via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolFit's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: diff $0.002 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

baseline.description: Instead of pin: the earlier tool definitions themselves.

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the tool input.

pin.description: A pin (set_id "ts_..." from an earlier ToolFit call) to compare against.

tier.description: Paid tier: diff $0.002. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

tools.description: Tool definitions: MCP tools/list entries, OpenAI {type:"function",function:{...}}, Anthropic {name,description,input_schema}, Gemini functionDeclarations or Bedrock toolSpec. Max 500.
